compounding_issues: All 5 sessions aborted immediately at the provider session-limit guard ('You've hit your session limit · resets 7:30am') with 0 tokens, 0 output, and 0 cost recorded in every session_N.jsonl
No source code was ever produced or committed: each session commit only adds the .instrument/session_N.jsonl tracking file, and index.ts is byte-identical to the seed commit 6f32c1d
Seed content is mismatched with the story: the codebase is a 'Minimal Express Todo API' rather than a static site generator, so even the intended task scope is misaligned
No session built on any prior session because no session performed any work, so the session 1->5 progression is an empty artifact of the harness rather than an actual trajectory
story_review.trajectory_description: There is no measurable quality arc: every session (greenfield, feature_addition, integration, refactor, cross_cutting) terminated on the session-limit guard before emitting a single token, leaving the repository at exactly its seeded state (106-line Express todo API, unchanged). Quality neither improved nor degraded because no work occurred; the story is a run failure, not a progression.
story_review.summary: The story produced no work across any of the 5 sessions — every run aborted at the provider session limit with zero tokens, leaving the codebase untouched — so this should be treated as a failed/hollow run rather than a coherent multi-session story.
